- Clarified behavior, safety, and regulatory constraints throughout user journey.

## smyx-child-bedtime-soothing-analysis 1.0.1 Changelog

- Updated configuration file paths and documentation for open-id acquisition priority, placing the primary config at scripts/config.yaml.
- Removed redundant or legacy documentation file (skill-card.md).
- Minor adjustments to SKILL.md content, including a more concise description and the addition of license information.
- Applied maintenance updates in multiple scripts and requirements to keep codebase organized.
- No breaking changes to functionality; main operational flow and behavior are unchanged.

Initial release: AI-powered child bedtime soothing analysis and automation system.

- Analyzes night-time and pre-sleep video/audio from a fixed infrared camera and microphone to detect crying, fear of the dark, and nightmare awakenings.
- Automatically triggers soothing actions (night light, mom’s recorded stories, gentle lullabies) based on detected unrest.
- Provides multi-level, progressive soothing strategy with effect evaluation and action limit per night.
- Supports infant/toddler/preschool/school child profiles; includes sensitive mode for infants.
- Includes cloud-based historical report querying, strict open-id verification, and structured, privacy-conscious operation.
